says: In next/, headPlace computes the next rev, pos and arrivedAt for the door's trial in its own SQL, while place computes the same three for the real append in separate queries (ledgerStore.ts:243-247). The trial is right only while the two agree. Smallest fix: have place take its rev, pos and arrivedAt from headPlace.
proof: ledgerStore.ts:243-247 (rev = head + 1; pos = max(pos) + 1; arrivedAt = max(now, last arrivedAt)) and :547-558 (the same three, in one SELECT).
cost: A later change to place that misses headPlace brings the early or late door refusal back, with only Q2 to catch it.
